correctness.rationale: In a finite irreflexive/transitive frame invalidating U_n, Goldblatt-Hodkinson correspondence gives n+1 successors y_i with incomparable futures. Transitivity forces distinct y_i to be pairwise R-incomparable, and every R(y_i) lies in Z=R(x)\Y. Sperner then gives |Z|>=q_n and |F|>=n+2+q_n. The explicit rooted height-two construction realizes any n+1 distinct central-layer subsets over q_n witnesses, is transitive because every root-to-y-to-z edge has its root-to-z closure, and realizes equality. The central-binomial asymptotic inverts to log2(n)+(1/2)log2log2(n)+O(1). Boundary n=1 gives q=2,N=5; the proof is specific to strict partial-order frames, not arbitrary frames.

value.rationale: The exact minimal finite obstruction to a modal width axiom is a natural size-complexity invariant in the strict-partial-order semantic class. The tight Sperner overhead and rooted attainment classify the threshold for all n rather than giving a generic antichain bound or an arbitrarily selected finite instance. Although it follows by a short reduction to known Sperner theory, that reduction identifies the exact modal counterframe cost and its asymptotics, useful for constructing small countermodels.
